data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in BMRC and FCBM.

BMRC disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing on October 16, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1403475/000140347526000041/bmrc-20261016.htm).

I publish Local Ledger from public records only, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
